title: Smart-Infinity: Fast Large Language Model Training using Near-Storage Processing on a Real System
problem: Storage-offloaded LLM training suffers from severe storage bandwidth bottlenecks. Large-parameter LLMs require extended memory hierarchy using host memory and storage, but storage bandwidth is orders of magnitude lower than GPU memory bandwidth.
motivation: Enabling efficient large language model training with limited GPU memory by removing the storage bandwidth bottleneck that constrains storage-offloaded training approaches.
method: Smart-Infinity offloads parameter updates to custom near-storage accelerators via SmartUpdate to eliminate most storage traffic. It proposes an efficient data transfer handler that overlaps transfers with fixed memory consumption through device buffer reuse. For multi-accelerator scaling, it performs gradient compression on GPUs and decompression on accelerators to reduce write traffic on the shared storage channel.
key_novelty: Moving parameter updates to near-storage processing accelerators to eliminate storage bandwidth bottleneck in storage-offloaded LLM training.
contributions: SmartUpdate: parameter update engine on near-storage accelerators eliminating most storage traffic
Efficient data transfer handler enabling overlapping transfers with fixed memory consumption
Accelerator-assisted gradient compression/decompression to reduce multi-accelerator write traffic bottleneck
Full PyTorch integration and real system implementation
